description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model, comparing two compression schemes—LB-Avg and RULER4k—under varying token and bit-precision configurations. The x-axis represents model layers, divided into five segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with each segment representing a range of layers. The y-axis measures the relative change in performance as a percentage, ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5%. Four distinct lines are plotted: the yellow line with circle markers represents the LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit; the red line with square markers represents the LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit; the cyan line with circle markers represents the RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit; and the dark blue line with square markers represents the RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit. The yellow line starts near 0% and remains relatively flat, hovering around 0% with a slight positive trend. The red line begins near 0%, dips slightly to approximately -2% around Layer5-12, and then stabilizes near -2%. The cyan line starts near 0%, declines to approximately -6% around Layer13-20, and then rises to approximately 0% near Layer29-32. The dark blue line begins near 0%, drops to approximately -15% around Layer13-20, and then rises to approximately 0% near Layer29-32. A dashed gray horizontal line at 0% serves as a reference for relative change.
